notes.title: Intro, Credits & More!
notes.content:
Hey Reptiles,

Over the past week, I have been hard at work fixing some minor bugs and creating a smoother experience for players. We now have a proper (albeit simple) introduction sequence to understand why Jeff isn't home with his mother anymore. We also added a proper credits sequence at the end, so pay attention to the environment!

Otherwise, there were some small bug fixes.

The game isn't perfect, it has some jank here and there, but its a solid experience through and through for Foddian lovers. This may be the last update to this game, I will be hard at work on the next one starting next month. If there are any major bugs I will fix them, just let me know! If interest is there, I can do a content update as well, we will just have to see.

(P.S. You may or may not see Jeff's dad, but you will see some environmental storytelling on where Jeff came from!)

notes.title: I HATE MY LEGS IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Hey, you reptiles! I HATE MY LEGS is officially live. I will say, that after the past month of marketing, I thought I would be more excited about this. I am actually terrified right now.

I have devoted much time and energy to this game, and it's still not perfect. There are some visual pop-in issues right now, specifically in the later areas/stages. I will be working tirelessly over the weekend to perfect this. I did not have the last few environments finished until around 12am last night, so I haven't slept trying to implement them perfectly. At the same time, I will create a better introduction and ending sequence for the "story" and the game as a whole.

As it stands, the end game is a platform that pops up your final time. This will be a "cinematic" sequence in the near future. 

Expect several small updates over the weekend, and a larger one next week if all goes well. I want this game to be a very smooth Foddian experience! 

Thank you all for the support, I look forward to seeing some playthroughs of the coming weeks, and making adjustments based on feedback!
